title: Designer: handing off design tokens
when: The designer sets the visual values once so every developer and page uses the same colors, type and spacing.
prompt:
Goal: A tokens.css with named custom properties on :root (and a dark scheme) that all styles reference, plus a short usage note.
Steps:
1. Name tokens by purpose, not by value: --color-text, --color-bg, --color-accent, --color-muted, --color-danger.
2. Add type tokens: --font-body, --font-heading, --size-1 to --size-6 on a ratio of about 1.25.
3. Add space tokens: --space-1 to --space-6 (0.25rem doubling up to 3rem) and --radius, --shadow.
4. Add a dark scheme in @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) that redefines only the color tokens.
5. Write a usage comment at the top: which token for body text, borders, buttons, errors.
6. Tell developers in a note to load tokens.css before style.css and never hard code a color.
Quality bar:
- Every color pair used for text reaches 4.5 to 1 in both schemes.
- Token names describe roles.
- The file is under 60 lines.
Pitfalls:
- Tokens named --blue-500 that break when the brand changes.
- Dark mode that only inverts the background.
- Developers still writing hex values in style.css.
Verify:
- [ ] All tokens on :root.
- [ ] Dark scheme block present.
- [ ] Usage comment present.
- [ ] Braces balance.
Output: tokens.css with :root and the dark scheme block, plus a note for the developers.

examples.input: cria as variaveis de cor e espaco do projeto
examples.output: --color-accent #7a3cff, --space-1 0.25rem to --space-6 3rem, dark overrides for text and bg
